connectionSpecification.description: Stages each batch as gzipped CSV in S3 and loads it with COPY into a typed table: overwrite, append or append_dedup.

host.description: Endpoint of the Redshift cluster or Serverless workgroup, without the port and database.
host.title: Host

schema.description: Schema every table is written to; it is created when missing. Redshift folds it to lower case.
schema.title: Default Schema

oneOf.description: Always encrypts; the server certificate is not verified.
oneOf.title: require

oneOf.description: Always encrypts and verifies the server certificate against the system roots and the host name.
oneOf.title: verify-full

oneOf.description: No encryption. Only for local test servers.
oneOf.title: disable

uploading_method.description: Batches are staged as gzipped CSV files in an S3 bucket and loaded with COPY.

access_key_id.description: Access key of an IAM user that may write, read and delete under the path. Empty uses the default AWS credential chain.
access_key_id.title: S3 Access Key Id

external_id.description: External ID the assumed role requires.
external_id.title: External ID

iam_role_arn.description: Role attached to the cluster that COPY uses to read the staged files (IAM_ROLE); a comma-separated list chains roles. Empty makes COPY use the upload credentials.
iam_role_arn.title: COPY IAM Role ARN

purge_staging_data.description: Delete the staged files once they are loaded.
purge_staging_data.title: Purge Staging Files

role_arn.description: Role the connector assumes on top of the keys or the default chain to upload; COPY then uses the role's temporary credentials unless iam_role_arn is set.
role_arn.title: Assumed Role ARN

s3_bucket_name.description: Bucket the batches are staged in.
s3_bucket_name.title: S3 Bucket Name

s3_bucket_path.description: Key prefix of the staged files.
s3_bucket_path.title: S3 Bucket Path

uploading_method.title: Uploading Method

connectionSpecification.title: Redshift Destination Spec
